title: Our Projects
subtitle: Sophisticated architectures. Open-source foundations.
description: Discover our production-ready AI templates, multi-agent frameworks, and deep integration models designed for high-performance B2B operations.

projects.title: Aegis Intelligence
projects.desc: A high-performance Cognitive deconstruction engine built with LangGraph and Cerebras Inference. Aegis systematically reduces dense technical material into axiomatic first principles, creating interactive step-by-step reassembly guides and auto-verifying comprehension. Clients deploy Aegis to slash corporate training cycles and unlock unstructured knowledge archives with sub-second retrieval speeds.

projects.title: Laura AI (Nexus Edit)
projects.desc: A hardware-accelerated native desktop editor compiled in Tauri 2.0. Laura AI processes heavy multi-track audio-video rendering locally while running a hybrid edge-cloud RAG pipeline. By combining localized speech transcription and automatic beat detection, Laura AI enables clients to automate narrative video generation and media workflows with total data privacy.

projects.title: SpellScroll Platform
projects.desc: An ASGI unified Django-FastAPI web platform delivering real-time recommendations. Powered by a stateful multi-agent LangGraph recommendation system, local MiniLM vector searches, and MangaDex APIs, SpellScroll serves as a high-retention content curation matrix. Enterprise clients integrate this engine to scale custom discovery portals and recommendation hubs.

projects.title: TerraTrace Agent
projects.desc: A stateful LangGraph-driven orchestrator designed to automate real estate title searches. It reads legacy property deeds, abstracts municipal easements and covenants, and maps chain of ownership titles into an interactive visual graph. Implemented with ChromaDB for local vector similarity and local LLMs to safeguard title records.

projects.title: LexisClear Playbook
projects.desc: An automated contract playbook auditor that accelerates legal review workflows. It parses commercial vendor agreements, highlights deviation risks against standardized firm playbooks using LangChain RAG, and generates contextual compromise redlines to dramatically shorten legal cycle times.

projects.title: Vanguard Compliance Engine
projects.desc: An ESG data ingestion and reporting pipeline that extracts regulatory compliance data from unstructured legacy ERP systems. Built with multi-agent workflows, it automatically parses transaction logs and energy consumption receipts into standardized Scope 1/2/3 carbon footprint reports.
